provenance_note: Owner-quality interpretation addendum. Not a new Codex/model execution. Preserves original sealed v1 output, reviewer alternatives, frozen M5C and provisional M6 labels.

amendments.customer_requirement: Privileged production access requires phishing-resistant MFA.
amendments.original_quote: Production admin authentication uses TOTP authenticator codes. No alternative phishing-resistant mechanism documented.
amendments.proposed_interpretation: The excerpt shows TOTP as a stated production administrator method. TOTP codes alone are not phishing-resistant. Record a provisional method-level concern, not a confirmed whole-path failure: another mandatory phishing-resistant factor and bypass/recovery enforcement are not established.

next_action.text: Check authorized existing configuration evidence for the complete mandatory production administrator authentication chain, including stronger factor and recovery/fallback routes.
next_action.fallback_if_absent: If no suitable existing evidence is available, request a narrowly scoped authentication policy and enforced configuration extract identifying each mandatory factor and any permitted bypass or recovery path.

amendments.residual_uncertainty: Whether an additional mandatory phishing-resistant factor protects every privileged route, and whether fallback routes bypass it, remain unknown.

amendments.customer_requirement: All production endpoints must reject TLS versions older than 1.2.
amendments.original_quote: Production listener 443 rejects TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1. TLS 1.3 is accepted. No other listeners are described.
amendments.proposed_interpretation: The supplied statement positively supports rejection of TLS 1.0 and 1.1 on listener 443. It does not prove whether 443 is the complete production endpoint population. Focus on missing endpoints and relevant below-1.2 rejection evidence for any uncovered endpoint; avoid generic or repeated tests of 443.

next_action.text: Check an existing authorized inventory to establish whether any other in-scope production listeners exist; for uncovered endpoints, check their minimum accepted TLS versions.
next_action.fallback_if_absent: If complete inventory or scoped test evidence is unavailable internally, request only the production endpoint list and TLS minimum-version evidence for endpoints not already evidenced.

amendments.residual_uncertainty: Whether other production endpoints exist or accept TLS versions below 1.2 is not established. No new weak endpoint is demonstrated.
